headline: HSBC Expands Middle East Footprint With New Abu Dhabi Wealth Centre
summary: HSBC announced plans to open a new wealth management centre in Abu Dhabi in December, reporting resilient regional client demand despite Middle East conflicts as part of a major investment push.
why: Global banks are aggressively scaling wealth management operations in the Gulf to capture growing private and sovereign capital flows.

impacts.name: HSBC Holdings plc
impacts.why: Targeted wealth management expansion in the UAE supports fee income growth.
